name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
summary: Krusk wants Lord Aliden Perenolde dead, and the Warchief's pendant recovered. Perenolde's manor lies north, on Lordamere Lake; his mistress Elysa knows about the pendant.

sections.title: The Lord of the Syndicate
sections.body: After Blackmoore's Legacy, Krusk says Perenolde must die and his foulness be ended. His manor lies north, on the shores of Lordamere Lake at Dandred's Fold. Once the deed is done, ask his mistress Elysa about Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires.

sections.title: A Frightened Mistress
sections.body: When you come to Elysa, she is terrified. She cries that she never meant your people harm, says Perenolde kept her against her will, and begs you to spare her.

faq.q: Who sends you to kill Lord Aliden Perenolde?
aliases: who gives lord aliden perenolde quest
where do i get lord aliden perenolde
faq.answer: Krusk sends you after you finish Blackmoore's Legacy.

faq.q: Where is Lord Aliden Perenolde located?
faq.answer: Perenolde is upstairs in his manor at Dandred's Fold, on the shores of Lordamere Lake, a way to the north.

faq.q: What item are you sent to retrieve after killing Perenolde?
faq.answer: You are sent to retrieve Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires. Ask Perenolde's mistress, Elysa, about it.

aliases: what is after lord aliden perenolde
faq.answer: Taretha's Gift comes next in the chain.
